tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in light, deep court green in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs sitting on paper.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, track behind meters, selected-row tint, empty states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Prefer a line over a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper copy, metadata, captions. 4.5:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand green: app icon ground, wordmark colour in light theme, brand panels.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Hero and brand panels. Lifted in dark so it does not vanish into paper.

tokens.name: pickle
tokens.usage: Mascot body and decorative brand fills. Never as text on paper (fails contrast).

tokens.name: pickle-ink
tokens.usage: Green that passes as text: links, positive deltas, selected states, the mascot stem.

tokens.name: ball
tokens.usage: Accent only: the pickleball, a single highlight, streak badges. Never text on paper.

tokens.name: action-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button and the one main action per screen.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action-bg.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px. 3:1 against paper in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Cautions such as an unsupported video or a low-confidence analysis.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only. One per page.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers: skill scores, streaks, session counts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hit 20 drops from the baseline and land 12 in the kitchen.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels and chip text. Set in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between tight items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wide screens, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding, top of page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets. Matches the app icon corner (22.5% of its side).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, meters, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for floating layers: bottom sheet, menu, toast. Cards use a line, not a shadow.
